title: ReviewHog
subtitle: AI-Powered Code Review Tool
description: AI-powered code review tool that integrates with GitHub, providing real-time feedback and suggestions to improve code quality.
problem: Manual pull request reviews are time-consuming and inconsistent across teams. Developers spend hours reviewing PRs, and feedback quality varies widely between reviewers.
solution: Built an AI-powered automation tool that reviews GitHub PRs and generates structured, consistent feedback using LangChain's AI pipeline.
architectureHighlights: Event-driven backend handling GitHub Webhook events
LangChain-powered AI pipeline for structured review comments

title: LoopChat
subtitle: Scalable Real-Time Chat Application
description: Highly scalable, real-time chat application built using React, Node.js, Express, and Socket.io. Features include user authentication, message history, and media sharing.
problem: Traditional polling-based chat systems create redundant server load and latency, leading to poor user experience at scale.
solution: Developed a real-time messaging platform using WebSockets, with optimized state management and media handling for a smooth, scalable chat experience.
architectureHighlights: Efficient global state management using Zustand

title: Thoughts
subtitle: Social Thought-Sharing Platform
description: A platform for sharing and discovering thoughts, built with React and Node.js.
problem: Social platforms are cluttered with noise. There's no minimal, focused space for sharing and discovering concise ideas.
solution: Built a clean, distraction-free platform focused purely on sharing short-form thoughts with a simple, modern UI.
impact: Fast load times with minimal design

title: GenMail
subtitle: AI-Powered Email Generator
description: An AI-powered email generation tool that helps users draft emails quickly and efficiently.
problem: Writing professional emails is tedious and time-consuming, especially when drafting from scratch repeatedly.
solution: Created an AI-powered tool that generates well-structured email drafts based on user prompts, saving time and ensuring professional communication.
architectureHighlights: OpenAI API integration for email generation
